dedupe_keys.name: garment variant material and component normalisation scripts

description: This Python workflow prepares garment-variant records for textile circularity analysis. RWTH Aachen University researchers publish six numbered scripts for removing empty records, expanding variants, harmonising keys and normalising materials, categories and components. CSV mapping tables, processing summaries and environment documentation explain the transformation used for the archived 47,522-record dataset. The GitHub README states MIT licensing for scripts and CC BY 4.0 for data and documentation, with free access. Coverage is the 2026 H&M and Uniqlo United Kingdom and Australian source collections. Acquisition scripts are excluded, so this repository cannot alone recreate collection from the original websites. Retailer-specific assumptions and mapping rules are limitations when adapting it to other apparel sources. Modellers could prepare composition inputs for recycling or material-flow simulations, including a separate model-odym workflow. The archive and maintained code are linked as complementary resources. No code body was downloaded or executed, and dependency installation was not tested.
name: Garment-variant material and component normalisation scripts
notes: G2-0484. Metadata only. Proposed simulation uses are reviewer assessments. No dataset, model or article PDF downloaded; no program executed.
